name: SecureScanner
description: An open-source security scanning tool that combines static analysis, dynamic testing, and dependency checking to identify vulnerabilities in web applications. Features include customizable scanning rules, CI/CD integration, and comprehensive reporting.

name: AuthGuardian
description: A secure authentication and authorization library for Node.js applications. Implements industry best practices including PKCE flow, JWTs with proper validation, rate limiting, and protection against common authentication attacks.

name: ThreatMapper
description: A visualization tool for mapping attack paths in complex network environments. Helps security teams identify potential attack vectors and prioritize remediation efforts based on risk scoring.

name: SecureHeaders
description: A middleware library for automatically implementing secure HTTP headers in web applications. Supports CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, and other security headers with sensible defaults and easy customization.
